coverage.summary: Applies statewide to tenancies held under a written lease. The section states no building size, construction-date or owner limits.
coverage.other_conditions: Tenancies under a written lease only. Tenancies at will are governed by G.L. c. 186, § 12.

evidence.quoted_span: Upon the neglect or refusal to pay the rent due under a written lease, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the lease

result.notes: I removed 'nonpayment of rent only' from other_conditions. It is the event that triggers the rule (tenant conduct), not a building, unit or owner attribute. The rule's requirement and key_value already capture it. The coverage limit that remains is that a written lease must exist. That limits a type of tenancy, not a class of buildings, so requires_unknown_facts is false. Section 11 sets no unit-count, construction-date or owner conditions, so those fields stay null. Tenancies at will fall under § 12 (D051), so I noted that in other_conditions.
